title: Regular and Electronic Trading Hours
content:
There are two options for displaying trading sessions for CME Group futures contracts:
Electronic Trading Hours (ETH) : This is the full session for the instrument, based on its official specifications.
Regular Trading Hours (RTH) : This reduced session displays data from 08:30am to 3:15pm CT.
Extended Trading Hours
Regular Trading Hours
To display and edit the ETH/RTH session break lines on the chart, right-click on the chart, select 'Settings,' and then choose 'Canvas.' To enable session break lines, check the box and adjust your display preferences as needed.
Display Settings
Restrictions:
This feature only affects intraday timeframes; daily, weekly, and monthly timeframes remain the same for both ETH and RTH.

To display and edit the ETH/RTH session break lines on the chart, right-click on the chart, select 'Settings,' and then choose 'Canvas.' To enable session break lines, check the box and adjust your display preferences as needed.
